en: There you are, {player}! Way too slow! That's a ten-million fine!
text: Aici erai, {player}! Prea încet! Amendă zece milioane!

en: Listen. Professor Rowan's back, right? So he's got to have loads of Pokémon. We ask him, he gives us one each. Easy!
text: Ascultă. Profesorul Rowan s-a întors, da? Deci sigur are o grămadă de Pokémoni. Noi îl rugăm, el ne dă câte unul. Simplu!

en: But the tall grass is in the way... So here's the plan: we run through it so fast the wild Pokémon can't catch us!
text: Dar ne stă în cale iarba înaltă... Deci uite planul: trecem prin ea atât de repede, că Pokémonii sălbatici nu ne pot prinde!

en: Ready? On three. One... two...
text: Gata? La trei. Unu... doi...

en: Wait! Stay right where you are!
text: Stați! Nu vă mișcați!

en: What do you think you are doing? Walking into tall grass without a Pokémon of your own is how people get hurt!

en: ......Huh? Hey! You're Professor Rowan! From the TV!

en: Hmm... Should I...? No. But then again...
text: Hmm... Oare să...? Nu. Totuși...

en: Prof. Rowan
text: Profesorul Rowan

en: Tell me truthfully. Do you love Pokémon?
text: Spune-mi sincer. Iubești Pokémonii?

en: Hey! What kind of answer is that? Tell him the truth!
text: Hei! Ce fel de răspuns e ăsta? Spune-i adevărul!

en: {rival}

en: See? We both love Pokémon! And that's never, ever going to change. Right, {player}?

en: Right?
text: Așa-i?

en: Ha ha, very funny. That joke's getting old already! Let's try that again.
text: Ha, ha, foarte amuzant. Gluma asta s-a învechit deja! Hai încă o dată.

en: Prof. Rowan
text: Profesorul Rowan

en: Hmm... Two children charging into tall grass. What would they do with Pokémon of their own, I wonder?
text: Hmm... Doi copii care dau năvală în iarba înaltă. Oare ce-ar face ei cu Pokémoni numai ai lor?

en: {rival}

en: Then give one to my friend, at least! Running into the grass was my idea, not theirs.
text: Atunci dați-i măcar celuilalt unul! Ideea cu iarba a fost a mea!

en: Prof. Rowan
text: Profesorul Rowan

en: ...You would speak up for your friend. Very well. I will trust you both with a Pokémon.
text: ...Iei apărarea celuilalt. Prea bine. Vă încredințez amândurora câte un Pokémon.

en: But promise me you will never be so reckless again. Now, where has my briefcase got to...?
text: Dar promiteți-mi că nu veți mai fi niciodată atât de nesăbuiți. Acum, unde mi-o fi servieta...?

en: I am. Today is the day these two set out.

en: But first! You know the lake past the western end of this road? They say a legendary Pokémon lives in it!
